name: mobile.forex/brokers
title: forex.mobile broker data
description: Forex broker data: regulation, spreads, fees, comparisons, recommendations, glossary, FX rates.

tools.name: list_brokers
tools.description: List the forex brokers forex.mobile reviews, highest editorial score first, with score, published minimum deposit and lowest published spread, retail regulators, platforms, Trustpilot rating and an affiliateUrl. Optional filters: country (only brokers whose own restricted-countries list was read and does not exclude it), islamic (only brokers whose own site offers a swap-free account), maxMinDeposit (USD) and platform. Broker scores are forex.mobile's editorial ratings out of 5, written by a named reviewer from each broker's published terms, regulator records and Trustpilot ratings. Spreads, deposits and platforms are the figures each broker publishes; forex.mobile does not trade real money with brokers or measure live spreads or execution. Methodology: https://forex.mobile/methodology

country.description: Country slug (e.g. uae, vietnam, india) or two-letter ISO code. Slugs: uae, saudi-arabia, kuwait, egypt, india, australia, uk, canada, nigeria, south-africa, france, singapore, us-traders, vietnam, thailand, philippines, indonesia, malaysia, japan, hong-kong, pakistan, kazakhstan, mongolia, ghana, bangladesh, kenya, morocco, tanzania, brazil, colombia, germany, italy, spain, netherlands, sweden, switzerland, sri-lanka, qatar, mexico

islamic.description: true: only brokers whose own site says it offers an Islamic (swap-free) account

maxMinDeposit.description: Only brokers whose published minimum deposit is at most this many US dollars

platform.description: Only brokers that list this platform, e.g. MT4, MT5, cTrader, TradingView

tools.name: get_broker

Spreads, deposits and platforms are the figures each broker publishes; forex.mobile does not trade real money with brokers or measure live spreads or execution. Methodology: https://forex.mobile/methodology

Broker scores are forex.mobile's editorial ratings out of 5, written by a named reviewer from each broker's published terms, regulator records and Trustpilot ratings. Spreads, deposits and platforms are the figures each broker publishes; forex.mobile does not trade real money with brokers or measure live spreads or execution. Methodology: https://forex.mobile/methodology

items.description: Broker key, one of: exness, xm, vantage, axi, tickmill, fpmarkets, roboforex, avatrade, icmarkets, oanda, plus500, etoro, deriv

tools.name: recommend_broker
tools.description: Top 3 brokers for a trader's country, the same answer as /api/v1/recommend: forex.mobile's ranking, limited to brokers whose own restricted-countries list was read and does not exclude the country, ordered by the chosen priority. priority: spreads (lowest published spread, the default), deposit (lowest published minimum), regulation (most top-tier retail licences); anything else uses the overall ranking. Broker scores are forex.mobile's editorial ratings out of 5, written by a named reviewer from each broker's published terms, regulator records and Trustpilot ratings. Spreads, deposits and platforms are the figures each broker publishes; forex.mobile does not trade real money with brokers or measure live spreads or execution. Methodology: https://forex.mobile/methodology

tools.name: glossary_term
tools.description: Definition of a forex term from the forex.mobile glossary (e.g. pip, spread, leverage, swap). Without a term, lists every term slug with its one-line definition.

term.description: Term slug, e.g. pip, margin-call, stop-loss

tools.name: search_guides
tools.description: Find forex.mobile articles and guides on a topic (e.g. "spread betting tax UK", "deposit with M-Pesa", "gold trading"), in English, Spanish or Arabic, newest and best matches first. Each result has its title, summary, language, date and URL, so an answer can cite the guide it rests on. Desk articles list their sources at the end of the page.

query.description: What the reader wants to know

tools.name: get_rate
tools.description: Reference exchange rate between two currencies (fiat from ExchangeRate-API, refreshed by the provider about once a day; BTC/ETH from CoinGecko against USD, EUR or GBP). Not a dealing price or a broker quote. Returns an error rather than a guess when the rate is unavailable.
